report.notes: Applied warm paper colors, serif typography, and outlined controls. Popup, recovery, interruption, and safety controls are positioned within the viewport. The final check passed.

differences: Page structure: the design's three adjacent document, form and details panes are replaced by a narrow navigation sidebar, a floating form in the center and a receipt on the right; the details table is absent.

Window frame: the desktop title bar, File/Edit/View/Tools/Help menu, document summary, record navigation and large zoom/fit/rotate toolbar are replaced by a compact web navigation bar and breadcrumb row.
Document area: the design's large bordered invoice viewer with a scrollbar becomes a small receipt surrounded by extensive empty space.

Task form: the design uses a full-height pane with a shaded title strip and large vertically stacked controls; the render uses a smaller white card with two-column fields, tiny labels and thin rectangular inputs.
Typography and styling: the design's large black serif text, strong borders and rounded pane corners become much smaller text, faint gray secondary labels, fine borders and purple or mint accents.
Bottom navigation: the design's prominent icon tabs are missing, replaced by a thin text status bar.
frame_issues: The header, side-panel and notification settings all display the instruction in the same top header; the side panel and notification presentations are absent.
The hidden instruction setting still shows a Submit end control and retains a sizable top bar labeled Hub despite specifying completion by message with no end control.
